description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and maximum activation value for different gating configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick marks at intervals of 50.  

A dashed blue line represents "attn_output", starting at approximately 2 at layer 0 and remaining near this value until layer 18, at which point it increases to roughly 140 by layer 22. A dotted orange line represents "attn_residual", beginning at a value of approximately 13 at layer 0, then holding steady around this value to layer 19, and then ascending to about 175 at layer 22. A solid red line represents "ffn_residual", starting at a value around 12 at layer 0, gradually increasing to approximately 70 at layer 18, and then sharply rising to approximately 380 at layer 22. Finally, a dashed green line corresponds to "ffn_output", initiating at around 4 at layer 0, remaining relatively constant until layer 18 where it begins to increase, reaching a value of around 150 at layer 22.
